title: Quietly Smoked Peruvian Prawns Suspiro Limeno
description: A fatty and silky solo dinner dish featuring raw frozen prawns, smoked to perfection in a cold and low fat friendly Peruvian suspiro limeno style
instructions: Preheat the smoker to 100 degrees Fahrenheit for cold smoking.
In a large bowl, whisk together dulce de leche, heavy cream, vanilla extract, cinnamon powder, smoked paprika, salt, and black pepper.
Add the thawed prawns to the bowl and toss to coat with the dulce de leche mixture.
Place the prawns in the smoker and smoke for 30 minutes.
Remove the prawns from the smoker and place them on a plate.
Drizzle the prawns with lemon juice and sprinkle with chopped pecans if using.
Serve the prawns immediately, garnished with additional cinnamon powder if desired.
Refrigerate any leftovers and consume within a day.
Before serving, let the dish sit at room temperature for 10 minutes to allow the flavors to meld together.
